theorem lg_target {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Semiring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] {f g : ι → α} [Fintype ι] (hfg : Antivary f g) : ↑(Fintype.card ι) * ∑ i, f i * g i ≤ (∑ i, f i) * ∑ i, g i := by
  let n := Fintype.card ι
  let sum_f := ∑ i, f i
  let sum_g := ∑ i, g i
  let sum_fg := ∑ i, f i * g i
  let sum_f_sq := ∑ i, f i * f i
  let sum_g_sq := ∑ i, g i * g i
  let sum_fg_sq := ∑ i, (f i * g i) * (f i * g i)
  let sum_f_g := sum_f * sum_g
  let sum_fg_n := n * sum_fg
  let sum_f_g_sq := sum_f_sq * sum_g_sq
  let sum_fg_sq_n := n * sum_fg_sq
  let sum_fg_sq_n_le_sum_f_g_sq : sum_fg_sq_n ≤ sum_f_g_sq :=
    by
      have h1 : ∀ i, (f i * g i) * (f i * g i) ≤ (f i * f i) * (g i * g i) :=
        λ i, mul_le_mul_left (mul_self_le_self (f i)) (mul_self_le_self (g i))
      let h2 : (∑ i, (f i * g i) * (f i * g i)) ≤ (∑ i, (f i * f i) * (g i * g i)) :=
        sum_le_sum h1
      rw [sum_fg_sq, sum_f_g_sq]
      exact h2
  have h3 : sum_fg_n ≤ sum_f_g_sq :=
    by rw [sum_fg_n, sum_f_g_sq]; exact mul_le_mul_left n sum_fg_sq_n_le_sum_f_g_sq
  have h4 : sum_f_g_sq ≤ sum_f_sq * sum_g_sq :=
    by rw [sum_f_g_sq, sum_fg_sq]; exact mul_le_mul_right sum_fg_sq_n_le_sum_f_g_sq n
  exact le_trans h3 h4
